newsitem.title: USA: SNET expands cable TV in Connecticut.
newsitem.headline: SNET expands cable TV in Connecticut.

text.p: Southern New England Telecommunications Corp (SNET) said Thursday it launched its cable television service in Fairfield County in southwestern Connecticut.
It said 7,200 homes in the county had signed up for SNET americast, which offers 80 channels.
SNET became the first company to compete in the state's cable TV market in March, when it launched its service in Unionville, Conn.
The company now serves 11,000 homes in the state.
The state Department of Public Utility Control in September 1996 granted SNET the first statewide cable TV franchise in the U.S.
The company plans to offer service to more than a third of Connecticut households by the end of next year.
SNET americast is the cable TV unit of SNET.
Nationally, americast is a consortium of Ameritech Corp., BellSouth Corp, GTE Corp, SBC Communications Inc. and Disney TeleVentures, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Walt Disney Company.
